SOVEREIGN AI — SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT
Department: Executive & Strategy
Classification: Confidential
Document ID: ES-COMP-002
Effective Date: 2026-06-15

EXECUTIVE COMPLIANCE CHECKLIST

Before approving a strategic initiative, executives should verify:

A. Data handling
- Sensitive data must have an assigned data owner.
- Confidential datasets must have documented access controls.
- Data retention periods must be recorded before production launch.

B. Third-party risk
- A vendor handling confidential information requires security due diligence.
- Critical vendors require an annual reassessment.
- Contracts must identify incident-notification responsibilities.

C. AI governance
- High-impact AI systems require documented human oversight.
- Model outputs used for financial decisions require an audit trail.
- Production model changes require version tracking and rollback capability.

D. Approval controls
- Unbudgeted spending above $250,000 requires executive approval.
- A material compliance exception requires a named owner and target remediation date.
- Exceptions older than 30 days must be reported to the Executive Risk Committee.

Compliance rule
No strategic initiative should be marked "approved" if a mandatory control has no owner or evidence.

Department: Executive & Strategy
Classification: Confidential
Document ID: ES-DEC-006
Meeting: Executive Risk Review — 2026-08-28

RECORDED DECISIONS

Decision 1
Project Sentinel may proceed to controlled pilot status. Production approval is blocked until model-change audit evidence is complete.

Decision 2
Platform Operations must submit a corrective action plan because Q2 spending was 8.75% above budget. The plan is due within 5 business days of the review.

Decision 3
The customer concentration risk at 24% is classified as High and remains open. Commercial Strategy must provide a diversification update at the next executive review.

Decision 4
Project Aurora remains a priority because disaster-recovery readiness is considered strategically important. The failover exercise target date is 2026-09-25.

Decision 5
No confidential dataset may be moved into a production AI workflow without an identified data owner and documented access controls.

Planning Period: Q3 2026

Q3 STRATEGY PLAN

Strategic priorities
1. Improve enterprise customer retention.
2. Reduce infrastructure cost per active customer.
3. Expand secure AI capabilities for regulated customers.
4. Improve operational resilience.

Quarterly targets
- Customer retention target: 94%.
- Infrastructure cost reduction target: 11%.
- Secure AI enterprise pilots: 8.
- Critical-service availability target: 99.95%.

Priority initiatives
Project Northstar: customer retention analytics. Owner: Strategy Analytics. Target completion: 2026-08-20.
Project Atlas: infrastructure efficiency program. Owner: Platform Operations. Target completion: 2026-09-15.
Project Sentinel: secure AI governance toolkit. Owner: AI Governance Office. Target completion: 2026-09-05.
Project Aurora: resilience and disaster-recovery exercise. Owner: Infrastructure Reliability. Target completion: 2026-09-25.

Decision rule
When resources conflict, initiatives directly connected to regulated-customer commitments receive priority over experimental initiatives, provided the compliance checklist is complete.
